instruction: A candid documentary photograph, medium shot, looking into the open back of an ambulance. Inside, the woman with blonde dreadlocks (R1) in a red paramedic uniform sits on the left, leaning forward to examine a blue medical bag. Beside her, the man with short red hair (R2), also in a red paramedic uniform, sits on the right, holding the blue medical bag on his lap and looking down at it. The interior of the ambulance features light green shelving. Natural daylight illuminates the scene, highlighting the red uniforms and blue bag.
